questions.solution:
Let coins be 2x, 3x, 4x.

Value = 5(2x) + 2(3x) + 1(4x)

= 10x + 6x + 4x = 20x = 200

→ x = 10 Coins: 20, 30, 40.

Answer: 20 coins of ₹5, 30 coins of ₹2, 40 coins of ₹1

questions.question: Simplify: (((0.5)³ + (0.05)³ + (0.005)³) ÷ ((0.1)³ + (0.01)³ + (0.001)³)
questions.solution:
0.5 = 5 × 0.1
0.05 = 5 × 0.01
0.005 = 5 × 0.001

So, every term in the numerator is 5 times the corresponding term in the denominator.

Since whole terms are raised to power 3:

Numerator = 5³ × Denominator

Therefore,

[((0.5)³ + (0.05)³ + (0.005)³)] / [((0.1)³ + (0.01)³ + (0.001)³)]

= 5³

= 125

Answer: 125
